subject.title: Plugin `message_sending` hooks silently bypassed on channel agent-reply delivery paths (2026.5.26, still present in 2026.6.1)

question: Should provider-owned preview-finalized replies use an internal channel-owned invocation of the existing `message_sending` guard, or should the repository first define a broader public provider-finalization hook contract?
rationale: Current main deliberately leaves provider-owned finalization outside the shared route, while the open candidate changes exactly-once and streaming visibility semantics; the permanent boundary cannot be chosen safely from a bug report alone.

options.title: Land a narrow internal finalizer repair
options.body: Rebase a focused successor to invoke the existing guard once at each provider-owned finalizer without expanding the public plugin API.

options.title: Standardize a public provider-finalization contract
options.body: Define and document a provider-facing lifecycle contract first, then implement the hook across providers against that contract.

options.title: Accept normal-route-only coverage
options.body: Keep the current partial repair and explicitly document that streamed provider finalization is outside the pre-send guarantee.

recommendation.title: Land a narrow internal finalizer repair
recommendation.body: Rebase a focused successor to invoke the existing guard once at each provider-owned finalizer without expanding the public plugin API.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the recent merged partial repair and are assigned to this issue’s remaining scope.
